global_texture.attribution: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio; visualizer Ernie Wright; scientist Noah Petro (NASA/GSFC). Color adapted from the LROC WAC Hapke Normalized Mosaic, with polar fill from LRO's Laser Altimeter Data Set (LDAM).

coverage.display_texture: Global rectangular longitude/latitude map, including both poles.
coverage.polar_fill: Latitudes outside the LROC WAC source range are filled with lower-resolution monochrome LDAM albedo; polar detail is not equivalent to WAC detail.

global_texture.projection: Equirectangular longitude/latitude (inferred from the 2:1 image and NASA's pixel-to-longitude/latitude description; the NASA page does not name a projection).
global_texture.orientation: Image top is north and bottom is south; image x increases from west to east. Verify the final rendered marker alignment against known features before release.

sphere_mapping.coordinate_basis: Prime meridian at +X; positive-east 90 degrees at -Z; lunar north at +Y.

global_texture.use: Display color only; this is not numerical elevation data and must not be used for terrain or physical calculations.

local_terrain.delivery: Runtime API heightmap; no source DEM or generated terrain grid is vendored in this repository.
local_terrain.source_footprint: 80 degrees south through the south pole
local_terrain.source_format: Float32 numerical GeoTIFF DEM; south-polar stereographic X/Y in metres; MOON_ME / JPL DE421; reference sphere radius 1737400 metres; NoData is NaN.

display_grid_contract.coordinate_mapping: Rows increase north; columns increase east; row-major index is row * width + column; scene x=east, y=up, z=-north.
display_grid_contract.elevation_m: Up displacement relative to the local scene origin; origin.elevation_m is the sampled source surface elevation.

previously_verified_shackleton_grid.evidence_status: Prior Stage 4 evidence only; not re-verified in this checkout.

local_terrain.readiness_note: A source footprint or product registration does not prove a particular site's current API coverage or a validated horizon model.
